blocks.text: DEMOLITION FAQ
Demolition Services in Schomberg — Crossroads Questions, Straight Answers

items.q: How is demolition priced in Schomberg?
a: One flat written figure per project, scoped free at your property, covering labour, take-down, loading, trucking and all disposal — with no village, distance or access premium anywhere in it. The approved number holds to the invoice whatever the structure was hiding.

items.q: We've got a few different structures that need to come down on the farm. Do you price those separately?
a: Not usually. The crew walks the whole property, sees everything that’s going, and quotes it as one job — one price, one visit, rather than several separate call-outs.

items.q: Will you be careful around our older Main Street building?
a: That’s the standard, not an exception. Anything near a heritage property gets handled with the same patience the building itself has earned over the years.

items.q: Can you take down a long fence line on a rural property?
a: Yes, and it prices the same flat way whether it’s forty feet or four hundred. Rural runs are common work for us here.

items.q: What does a pool or hot tub demolition actually involve?
a: The water drains first, then the shell gets cut apart and hauled — the whole thing broken down properly rather than pulled out in one piece, which usually isn’t possible anyway.
